diagnostic.problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.
diagnostic.cause: Windows may still be using the old cached password for eduroam after the password change.
steps: Forget the eduroam network in Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi
Reconnect to eduroam and enter the new password (ensure it's case-sensitive)
Check if the university account is active and verify no service outages
